headline: Crude Oil Drops on Middle East Export Recovery; Indian Bonds Gain
summary: Brent crude futures fell nearly 1% as recovering Middle East oil shipments offset worries over regional tanker attacks. Lower energy prices eased inflation fears in India, pushing the benchmark 10-year bond yield down to 7.2813%.
why: Crude oil is the world's most traded physical commodity. Plunging oil prices reduce import bills and inflationary pressures for major net importers like India.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: A rebound in Middle East crude exports increased market supply expectations, lowering oil prices.

impacts.why: Lower crude oil import costs ease domestic inflation risks and curb central bank rate hike expectations.
